observed_failure.error: Cannot overwrite variable Pid because it is read-only or constant.

root_cause.detail: PowerShell variable names are case-insensitive. Function parameter [int]$Pid collides with automatic read-only variable $PID, so parameter binding fails before Get-ProcessSnapshot can execute.

environment_adjudication.reason: The diagnostic did not emit its bounded final result. Any internal observations made before the exception were not returned as a complete attributable artifact.
